page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.se1ne family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs and 480 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.57 GB per core. This configuration positions the instance as a memory-optimized resource designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources.

The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or GPU-based machine learning tasks. For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server type.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.se1ne.14xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. This server is best suited for workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
